about: Launch years for famous products whose Wikidata items have only an inception date (P571), which is often the invention or the company's founding. analysis/items_pipeline/wikidata_pool.py merges them into product_released as fact-checked items. Each year was checked against the source's text (lead, history or infobox) on 2026-10-04; `event` names the launch event chosen.

items.event: launched on 15 January 2001
